generated_note: Truthful current-state inventory of declared sensitive data flows. Where a field does not apply it is 'not_applicable' rather than guessed. Validated by scripts/policy/verify_data_safety_drift.py.

device_security_findings.purpose: On-device malware/spyware scan results presented to the user; scan artifacts stay on-device.
device_security_findings.retention: Until next scan or user-initiated clear.
device_security_findings.user_control: Scans are user-triggered; results are clearable from in-app settings.

app_package_metadata.purpose: Enumerate installed apps (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES) to match against spyware package indicators; declared to Play Console as a core device-security feature.
app_package_metadata.retention: Session/scoped per scan; not persisted between launches.
app_package_metadata.user_control: Granted via the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES prompt; feature can be withheld if permission is denied.

network_security_observations.purpose: The privacy VPN observes outbound connection attempts to known tracker/surveillance domains and blocks them.
network_security_observations.retention: Per VPN session; not persisted to disk.
network_security_observations.user_control: User enables/disables the privacy VPN from the Shield screen; disabling tears down the VpnService.

crash_performance_telemetry.purpose: Not collected. No crash-reporting or performance-telemetry SDK is integrated.

authentication_identity.purpose: Google Play Billing obfuscated account ID used for entitlement verification. No raw account IDs are collected or stored remotely by CoreGuard.
authentication_identity.retention: Entitlement cache lifetime; obfuscated ID is not persisted as user identity.
authentication_identity.user_control: Subscription and account are managed via the Google Play Store; sign-out clears the local entitlement cache.

billing_entitlement.purpose: Premium subscription entitlement verified through Google Play Billing.
billing_entitlement.retention: Subscription lifetime; entitlement cached locally for offline access state.
billing_entitlement.user_control: Purchase, upgrade, and cancellation are handled via the Google Play Store.

threat_intelligence_requests.purpose: Download signed threat-intelligence bundles from the Cloud Run backend to update on-device spyware/tracker domain blocklists.
threat_intelligence_requests.retention: Per bundle version; superseded bundles are replaced on update.
threat_intelligence_requests.user_control: Threat-intel updates can be enabled or disabled in settings.

quilla_inputs_outputs.purpose: Quilla defensive crawler (operator tooling, not app runtime) gathers open-source intelligence into signed bundles stored as artifacts.
quilla_inputs_outputs.user_control: Operator-run build tooling; not a user-facing data flow.
